code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != grid[0][0]]
    if not points:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in points)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in points)
    background = grid[0][0]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1):
                if out[r][c] == background:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''

p.write_text(code)
